subject: Dedicated cluster sizing questionnaire — CinderBio (follow-up)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Conway <sasha@cinderbio.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-22 09:15 -0800
Subject: Dedicated cluster sizing questionnaire — CinderBio (initial)

Hi Sasha,

Great to meet earlier today — thanks again for walking through the high-level requirements. To move the Dedicated sizing work forward we need a short, focused profile of your traffic and prompt/response characteristics. I attached our lightweight preflight template (redwood_preflight_template.xlsx) — the fields that matter most for sizing are in the first two tabs.

If it helps, here are the specific items we need filled out:
- Expected steady-state concurrent sessions (avg and peak) and any recurring daily windows.
- Breakdown of call types: interactive chat (LLM), batch generation (nightly jobs), and embeddings for semantic search (approx %).
- Typical prompt tokens and response tokens per call (p50/p95) and any long-tail prompts.
- Session duration distribution (median, 95th) and whether sessions keep KV cache alive across calls.
- SLA targets you expect (p50/p95 generation latency in ms) and acceptable cold-start windows.
- Any data residency/PHI requirements and whether we need tenant isolation on hardware.

Quick example (helpful to mirror in the sheet): 1k daily active users, 250 concurrent steady, 1.2k peak concur during 10–11am PT; 80% interactive, 20% embedding/batch; median prompt 45 tokens, median response 110 tokens, p95 response 800 tokens; KV cache per session, 10% cache hits on repeat calls.

If you can send the sheet back by end of day today or tomorrow morning Jordan and I will start a preliminary estimate and flag any questions for Karthik (pre-sales infra). Once we have the answers we can schedule a 30–45 minute sizing call to review the plan.

Thanks — talk soon.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwood.com | M: (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Dedicated cluster sizing questionnaire — CinderBio (answers)

Hi Evelyn — thanks, attached is our completed sheet (cinderbio_preflight_answers.pdf). I pasted the highlights inline to make it easier for your team: 

- Business profile: experimental genomics SaaS, ~20k monthly users, heavy nightly batch embedding to reindex results.
- Concurrency: steady 300 concurrent sessions; routine daily peak 1,100 concurrent between 09:30–10:15 PT; occasional marketing-driven spikes up to 2,500 concurrent (rare, <4 days/month).
- Call mix: 65% interactive LLM chat (short Q&A and summarization), 25% embeddings (both real-time and nightly batch), 10% long-form generation (reports).
- Prompt/response tokens: interactive p50 prompt 60 tokens / p50 response 140 tokens; interactive p95 response 650 tokens. Long-form generation typical prompt 220 tokens / response 2,400 tokens (p50). Embedding payloads: avg 1,200 tokens per document for nightly jobs.
- Session behavior: sessions are sticky for up to 20 minutes and maintain KV cache for follow-ups; ~30% of interactive sessions reuse context leading to higher cache-hit ratio (approx 40% reuse).
- SLA/latency: target p50 < 120ms, p95 < 450ms for interactive calls. Long-form can be relaxed to p95 < 3s.
- Security: PHI in some records — requirement for dedicated tenant hardware with isolated storage and KMS integration.

Open questions from our side: do you support pre-warming for predictable daily peaks, and do you have recommendations for handling the rare 2.5k spikes (burst routing/fallback to smaller model)? Also attaching a link to our telemetry for sample sessions: https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/cinderbio-telemetry/session-samples-20281122.json.

Thanks — Sasha
Sasha Conway
Head of Infrastructure | CinderBio
sasha@cinderbio.com

Attachment: cinderbio_preflight_answers.pdf (PDF)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-23 08:40 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated cluster sizing questionnaire — CinderBio (internal clarifications)

Evelyn / Jordan — reviewing Sasha's numbers. A couple clarifications I need before drafting a hardware footprint: 
1) Batch embedding cadence: is that a single nightly job window (e.g., 2am–4am) or staggered per-tenant windows? If single window with 1.2k tokens per doc and X docs/day we'll need sustained throughput planning vs. background low-priority slots.
2) For the 2,500 spike: are you able to accept graceful degradation (e.g., fallback to quantized model with ~2x latency increase but lower GPU memory) or does that break product UX?
3) KV cache semantics: when sessions keep KV alive for 20 minutes, do follow-ups arrive within 10s–30s or are they human-paced (minutes)? The former affects token-per-second pressure.

If you can get quick answers we can propose an initial dedicated pool — likely a mix of A100-class reserved nodes for long-form and medium-quantized GPUs (L4-style) behind a routing policy for the interactive tier. Also will need PHI compliance notes for Private deployment (KMS/HSM).

Karthik
Senior Pre-Sales — Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Conway <sasha@cinderbio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, procurement <procurement@cinderbio.com>
Date: 2028-11-23 10:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated cluster sizing questionnaire — CinderBio (next steps)

Thanks Sasha — that sheet is perfect and very helpful. Quick answers to Karthik's clarifying points (copied from Sasha's notes):
- Batch embedding cadence: single nightly window from ~01:30–03:45 PT; staggered only per feature rollout, otherwise consolidated.
- Spike behavior: product team prefers graceful degradation over hard failures — fallback to a smaller quantized variant is acceptable for marketing spikes (best-effort).
- KV cache timing: follow-ups are typically human-paced (20s–5min) with median inter-call 40s on interactive flows.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Karthik and Jordan will produce a 2-page preliminary footprint (node counts by SKU, estimated token/sec capacity, suggested routing/fallback) by EOD tomorrow.
2) I'll schedule a 45-minute technical sizing call for Friday 11/24 at 10:00 PT (invite to follow).
3) Procurement — please confirm any required PO templates or onboarding timelines so we can align the Dedicated commitment proposal.

Sasha — can you confirm Friday 10:00 PT works and whether Ravi should join for procurement/contract questions?

Best,
Evelyn
